# KalnyesGrowth - Full Documentation

> Client Acquisition Systems for Local Businesses | Stafford, Virginia

## About

KalnyesGrowth is a client acquisition agency founded by Jose Jessyt Morales in Stafford, Virginia. We serve local service businesses (barbers, restaurants, contractors, HVAC, plumbers, landscapers, auto repair, nail salons, and more) across Northern Virginia and nationwide.

We are not a traditional marketing agency. We build systems that actively work for your business every day. Instead of just building a website and disappearing, we create automated client acquisition systems that capture leads, follow up instantly, manage online reputation, and track everything in one dashboard.

We are bilingual (English and Spanish) and specialize in serving Hispanic-owned businesses.

## How It Works

1. **Book a Discovery Call**: 15-minute video call where we learn about your business and identify where you're losing customers.
2. **We Build Your System**: Custom website + AI tools configured for your specific business, built in 48 hours.
3. **Review Your Free Demo**: You see a working demo of your website and AI receptionist before spending anything.
4. **Launch**: If you love it, pick a plan. If not, no hard feelings.

## AI Agent Capabilities

### AI Voice Receptionist
Answers every phone call 24/7 in your brand voice. Books appointments, answers frequently asked questions, takes messages, and transfers urgent calls. Trained specifically on your business information, services, pricing, and hours.

### Missed-Call Text Back
When a call goes unanswered, the system automatically sends a personalized text message within 60 seconds. 85% of missed callers never call back. This agent catches them before they call your competitor.

### Reviews Automation
Automatically requests Google reviews from happy customers after their appointment or service. Monitors all review platforms. AI generates professional responses to both positive and negative reviews in your voice.

### AI Webchat
A chat widget on your website that answers visitor questions instantly, captures contact information, and qualifies leads. Works 24/7. Knows your services, pricing, hours, and FAQs.

### Unified Messaging Inbox
One inbox for all customer communications: SMS, email, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, Google Business Messages, and website chat. No more checking 6 different apps.

### CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
Track every lead, customer, and conversation in one place. See the full history of every interaction. Know which leads are hot and which need follow-up.

### Payments
Send invoices via text or email. Customers pay with one tap. No more chasing payments or dealing with cash only.

### Appointment Reminders
Automated SMS and email reminders sent before appointments. Reduces no-shows by up to 70%.

### Social Media Manager
Schedule and publish posts across Instagram, Facebook, Google Business Profile, and more from one dashboard.

### Email & SMS Campaigns
Send promotions, seasonal offers, and updates to your entire customer list. Segmented targeting available.

### Online Booking
Customers book appointments directly from your website or Google Business Profile. Syncs with your calendar.

### Customer Reactivation
Automatically identifies customers who haven't visited in 60+ days and sends win-back campaigns via text and email.

## Pricing

### AI Systems (Monthly Subscription)

**Core Plan - $1,497/month**
Includes: Custom website, AI Voice Receptionist, Missed-Call Text Back, Reviews Automation, and monthly reporting.

**Growth Plan - $2,497/month**
Includes everything in Core plus: CRM, Payments, Appointment Reminders, Email & SMS Campaigns, and quarterly strategy calls.

**Scale Plan - $2,997/month**
Includes everything in Growth plus: Social Media Manager, Customer Reactivation, Online Booking, priority support, and monthly strategy calls.

### Individual AI Agents
Each agent is available individually for $497 to $1,297 per month, depending on the agent.

### SEO / Google Visibility Plans (Monthly)

**Foundation - $497/month**
Google Business Profile optimization, on-page SEO for all service pages, 30+ local directory listings, technical site health monitoring, and monthly ranking report.

**Growth - $897/month**
Everything in Foundation plus 2 SEO blog posts per month, review generation strategy, competitor ranking monitoring, 50+ directory citations, and quarterly strategy calls.

**Dominate - $1,297/month**
Everything in Growth plus 4 blog posts per month, backlink building campaigns, Google Ads management (ad spend separate), monthly strategy calls, and priority response time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is a client acquisition system?
It's an automated system that captures leads, follows up instantly, manages your online reputation, and tracks everything in one place. Think of it as a digital team that works 24/7 so you don't have to answer every call, chase every lead, or manually request reviews.

### How is this different from other marketing agencies?
Most agencies build you a website and disappear. We build systems that actively work for your business every day. AI handles your calls, follows up on leads, manages reviews, and books appointments.

### How long does it take to see results?
Most clients see their first new leads within 30 days of launch. The system improves over time as it learns your market and customer patterns. Full optimization typically takes 60-90 days.

### Do I need a website already?
No. Our systems include everything you need. If you already have a website, we can integrate with it. If you don't, we'll build one as part of your system.

### How long until I see SEO results?
Most businesses see initial movement within 30-60 days and significant results in 3-6 months. Once you're ranking, you stay ranking as long as we keep working. It compounds over time.

### Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. No long-term contracts on any plan. You stay because it's working, not because you're locked in. If you cancel, you keep your website.

### Do you work with businesses outside Virginia?
Yes. About 40% of our clients are outside Northern Virginia. The technology works the same everywhere.
